info.title: OpenAppPlatform API
info.description: Single self-hosted workspace with owner sessions, invite-only roles, app-scoped agents and mutation audit. HTTP 202 queues a release; poll its ID. Preview mode is isolated/local only.

put.summary: Update future release configuration without restarting workloads

expectedVersion.description: If positive, reject a new release when this definition version has changed.

post.summary: Recheck an exact provider deployment or retry preparation before dispatch
post.description: Requires an attention state and its current updatedAt. Never reissues an uncertain deployment. Missing provider IDs must be identified by the owner; resource association is verified. Unfinished instances resume once all attention steps are resolved.

post.summary: Queue restart of one existing instance
post.description: Restarts the bound runtime without applying saved future configuration. Serialized with deployments and guarded by definition version and idempotency key. Uncertain dispatch enters attention.

post.summary: Retire highest instance ordinals and commit a lower desired count
post.description: Docker managed components only. Requires a lower positive count, definition version, and idempotency key. Stops selected instances without deleting resources or volumes; count changes only after all stops are confirmed. Configuration edits and other operations are blocked during retirement. Bindings remain reserved and can be reactivated by deployment.

SessionCookie.name: __Host-oap-session
SessionCookie.description: HttpOnly browser session. Writes require X-OAP-CSRF: 1 and a permitted Origin. Local HTTP uses oap-session instead.

port.description: Zero allowed only for observe-only resources whose operator does not report a port.

hostPort.description: Zero keeps a component private. A fixed host port requires one instance.

env.description: Plain non-secret runtime variables. Coolify mutates only recorded OAP-owned production variables; unrelated and preview variables remain operator-managed.

services.description: Environment variable to component name. Uses application DNS on Docker or a supplied explicit endpoint; adopted targets require an explicit endpoint.

serviceEndpoints.description: Referenced component name to explicit operator-managed HTTP(S) endpoint. Required for Coolify connections; no credentials, query, or fragment.

management.description: New existing-resource registrations always start observe-only. Omitted on existing managed definitions. Enable lifecycle management using the explicit handoff endpoint.

applicationId.description: Existing OAP reservation, when present on discovery.

source.description: Pinned GitHub repository/commit/ref/delivery provenance supplied by the trusted source pipeline.

retired.description: Retained instance reserved for this application after confirmed stop.
